scope: National Australian news and official documents published in or around 2006-2009 that publicly ranked China in Australia's trade hierarchy.
interpretation_rule: A query with no verifiable recovered document records a retrieval gap only; it is never coded as evidence that coverage did not exist.

queries.purpose: Locate contemporaneous Australian Financial Review coverage in 2006.
queries.notes: The 2009 AFR article was recovered separately; no directly verifiable 2006 AFR article was found in this round.

queries.query: site:rba.gov.au 2006 China second-largest export destination Australia Japan
queries.purpose: Separate export-destination rank from two-way partner rank in 2006.
queries.notes: The RBA box was published in November 2006 but its rank refers to calendar 2005.

queries.query: Australia's Composition of Trade 2007 2008 2008-09 China largest two-way trading partner
queries.purpose: Distinguish calendar-year and fiscal-year official rankings.
queries.notes: Calendar 2007 has China first, calendar 2008 has Japan first, and fiscal 2008-09 has China first in two-way goods-and-services trade.
